submitted.rationale: Of the five compositions measured (Sb 0.28, 0.49, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80), index 20 (Sb 0.70) had the highest EQE at 0.00377%. Photoactivity only appears on the Sb-rich side and drops at 0.75 (0.00228%) and 0.80 (0.00159%). XRD at 0.61, 0.70 and 0.75 shows peaks near Q≈1.92, 2.48 and 3.68 Å⁻¹. These look like rutile but were not matched to reference patterns. The peak at 5.33 is probably the Pt substrate. The optimum seems to lie near Sb 0.65–0.70, close to CrSb2O6 (0.667).

rejected.reason: 0.00228%, lower than Sb 0.70 even though its rutile-like XRD peaks were strongest
Not measured because the EQE budget ran out. The GP model predicted a lower mean than the measured 0.00377% at idx 20.
